title: Encoder · Raw patch bottleneck MAE
summary: Own the RPB-MAE encoder family, its versioned instances and preserved model-owned evidence; suitability remains specific to a declared operation.

goals.title: Preserve the RPB family and evidence
goals.description: Keep existing versions, failures and original protocols traceable.

milestones.title: Preserve RPB versions and original research records
milestones.description: The family and historical evidence remain in the imported component; no existing version is promoted to a universal default.
acceptance: The family guide and versioned source are retained under the verified component migration.

goals.title: Expose an explicitly selected RPB instance
goals.description: Bind native layout, fitted preprocessing and checkpoint identity to a declared representation space.

milestones.title: Select and verify an operation-facing RPB contract
milestones.description: Select a version and trained RPB instance for a declared operation, document native outputs and masks, and verify record, fit-artifact and temporal compatibility. Preserve earlier scoped results and comparison limits; no instance becomes a universal default.
acceptance: Bind the exact checkpoint/content identity, architecture/configuration, trained preprocessing, output selector/layout and normalization, plus training/exposure provenance or explicit unknowns. A family/version label alone does not identify an experimental instance.

Provide source/support and availability metadata under foundations-temporal-integrity. End-of-window encodings may use the full available window but must not be labeled prefix-causal without the corresponding dependency and perturbation evidence.

Conformance tests exercise source hashes, native shapes, masks, non-finite data, changed preprocessing and incompatible consumer/index cases. The proposed starter composition is blocked until this bound provider contract and its engineering checks are available.

Retain original research receipts and failures under their original protocols. A probe follows or-05-readouts-probe-protocol; a provider implementation receipt is not evidence that retrieval, risk prediction or dynamics are useful.
